map.为什么方差除以 n 而不是 n−1？: Why Is the Variance Divided by n Instead of n−1?
map.均值告诉你整体情绪倾向，标准差告诉你分歧有多大。危机研判里两者都关键：均值骤降说: The mean tells you the overall sentiment tendency and the standard deviation tells you how much the opinions diverge. Both matter in crisis assessment: a sharp drop in the mean means the overall tone has turned negative, while a sharp rise in the standard deviation means public opinion has split with opposing camps. This tool only does descriptive statistics; to draw a conclusion about "significance" (whether two windows really differ) you need a separate t test or Mann-Whitney U test.
map.均值和标准差哪个更能反映舆论风险？: Which Reflects Public Opinion Risk Better, the Mean or the Standard Deviation?
map.对比两个时间窗口（如危机前 vs 危机中）的情感均值与标准差，判断舆论是否显著恶: Compare the sentiment mean and standard deviation of two time windows (for example before vs during a crisis) to judge whether public opinion has deteriorated significantly.
map.把 min/max 与极差结合看：若极差很大而均值温和，说明存在少量极端负面帖，: Look at the min/max together with the range: if the range is very large while the mean is mild, there are a few extremely negative posts that need separate handling rather than just looking at the average.

map.舆情监测日报表里收集到一批单条微博/新闻的情感打分（如 −100~+100 或: A monitoring daily report has collected sentiment scores for individual posts or news items (such as −100 to +100 or 1 to 100); use descriptive statistics to see the overall mean, the fluctuation, and the extremes.
map.除以 n 是总体方差，用于把这 8 条当作全部观察对象、只描述其离散程度；除以: Dividing by n gives the population variance, used when these 8 items are all the observed objects and you only describe their dispersion; dividing by n−1 gives the sample variance, used to infer the population from a sample. This tool uses the population basis; if you want to treat these 8 items as a sample estimating the population fluctuation, convert with n/(n−1) yourself (in this example 525.00 × 8/7 = 600.00, standard deviation about 24.49).
map.：8 条舆情情感得分 10、20、30、40、50、60、70、80：n = 8: : Eight sentiment scores 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80: n = 8, sum 360.00, mean 45.00, median 45.00, minimum 10, maximum 80, range 70.00, variance 525.00, standard deviation 22.91. Mean = median shows the distribution is symmetric; but a standard deviation of 22.91 against a mean of 45 is a coefficient of variation of about 51%, so individual sentiment scores fluctuate hugely. Looking only at the mean of 45 would hide individual extreme negative (10) or extreme positive (80) events, so read it together with the range and the max/min.
map.：样本量 n；总和；算术均值 = 总和 ÷ n；中位数（n 奇数取中间值，偶数取: : Count n; sum; arithmetic mean = sum ÷ n; median (for odd n the middle value, for even n the mean of the two middle values); minimum, maximum, and range; variance on the population basis = Σ(x − mean)² ÷ n; standard deviation = √variance.
